stemMd:
A team studying a coastal plant found that seeds collected from sheltered sites germinated well in calm conditions but poorly under strong salt spray. Seeds from exposed sites germinated under both conditions. The team therefore cautioned that collecting only from sheltered sites could ______.

Which choice most logically completes the text?

options.label: A
options.textMd: prove that no seeds can germinate near the coast

options.label: B
options.textMd: omit variation useful for restoration in exposed coastal habitats

options.label: C
options.textMd: ensure identical performance in every future habitat

options.label: D
options.textMd: eliminate the need to record collection locations

explanationMd: The exposed-site seeds possess performance capacity not represented equally by sheltered-site seeds. A sheltered-only collection could therefore miss traits valuable where salt spray is strong.

distractorRationale.a: Seeds from exposed sites germinated in both conditions.
distractorRationale.d: Location is relevant to the observed variation.
